name: Evolution Go Engine
description: External Evolution Go service engine adapter for OpenWA — HTTP client, no in-process WhatsApp protocol and no browser
author: OpenWA Team

baseUrl.title: Service URL
baseUrl.description: Where the Evolution Go service answers

apiKey.title: Global API Key
apiKey.description: Global key of the engine deployment, used to create and delete instances

callbackBaseUrl.title: Callback Base URL
callbackBaseUrl.description: Address at which the ENGINE reaches this OpenWA instance (webhook + media URLs). Must not be localhost.

ingressSecret.title: Ingress Secret
ingressSecret.description: Shared secret on the engine's ingress path. Required: the engine's webhook is unsigned.

instancePrefix.title: Instance Prefix
instancePrefix.description: Prefix for every remote instance this gateway owns

stateDir.title: State Directory
stateDir.description: Per-session state dir holding the remote instance id and token
